name: Bollinger z-score washout reversion, chop-gated (15m)
rationale: A deeply negative Bollinger z-score on 15m marks a statistically unusual washout; gating on ADX below a ceiling ensures we only fade in a NON-trending regime where band extremes revert rather than in a trend where they extend. The other side is the panic seller / forced liquidation who dumps into thin books and pays the reversion premium. Edge persists because short-horizon overreaction in range-bound crypto is structural. Distinct from RSI reversion (band-relative, not momentum-relative). Disconfirmer: exits when z-score reverts toward zero, or the stop fires if the washout was the start of a real breakdown.
catalyst: statistically unusual downside dislocation in a non-trending regime
